title: Radiant Nuclear button
description: A flat, square-cornered button: a translucent dark wash (40%) with a bold 14px white label, darkening to 80% on hover in 150ms. Reads on cream, on the tan band and over photos alike.
notes: a link (<a>) when given href, otherwise a <button>
in dark mode the wash turns solid so the label keeps its contrast
name: radiantnuclear-button
